description: How characters are drawn, animated, and treated visually.
prompt_template:
Given this style guide:
{style_guide}
And this gameplay style:
{prior_picks.gameplay_style}

Generate {count} distinct character style options covering:
- Silhouette type: chunky | slim | geometric | organic | abstract | mascot
- Portrait treatment: floating_head | half_body | full_body | no_portrait
- Animation: 1-frame static, 2-frame breathe, 4-frame walk, 8-frame walk, custom
- Detail level: minimal (eyes only) | moderate | detailed (clothing, accessories)
- Dither style for face: atkinson | bayer_4x4 | bayer_8x8 | line | none

Match sprite_dimensions to the gameplay sprite_size_recommendation when possible.
Return a JSON array of exactly {count} options matching option_schema.
refinement_prompt: Revise the character option below per the user feedback. Keep sprite + portrait dims within Playdate limits (sprite ≥ 16x16, portrait ≤ 200x200).

option_schema.name: string
option_schema.silhouette: enum: chunky | slim | geometric | organic | abstract | mascot
option_schema.face_dither: enum: atkinson | bayer_4x4 | bayer_8x8 | line | none
